fields.name: Entity
fields.evidence: Not replicated. Windows creator bg3.exe+0x2E9F6E0 (ComponentFrameStorageAllocRaw 0x18, the only caller is bg3.exe+0x2E9E370) stores its entity argument - the same value it uses as the key of the storage's entity map - at +0 and zeroes the array at +8: the handle of the entity that owns the component. macOS default ctor: null handle.

fields.name: Requests
fields.evidence: Windows type name ls::FieldMeta<class ls::DynamicArray<struct eoc::swap_places::AnimationRequestData,struct ls::TaggedAllocator<int> > eoc::swap_places::AnimationRequestComponent::*,8>; macOS m_Requests. Serializer bg3.exe+0x8E5FE0 -> bg3.exe+0xA7FD00 (stride 0x18). Windows: the replication writer bg3.exe+0x8E5FE0 passes +8 to the array writer bg3.exe+0xA7FD00 (count from +0xC, stride 0x18).

fields.name: Source
fields.evidence: Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0x5D7C70 ProcessSwapPlacesRequests: the animation element is built as {request +0 (source handle), request +8 (target handle), the two bools at request +0x14}; esv::animation::GameplaySystem::ProcessSwapPlacesAnimationRequests (EoCServer.dll+0x1517940) triggers EoCGE::PositionSwap(true, +0x10, +0x11) on element +0.

fields.name: Target
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x5D7C70: element +8 = the request's target handle; EoCServer.dll+0x1517940 triggers EoCGE::PositionSwap(false, +0x10, +0x11) on element +8.

fields.name: field_10
fields.evidence: Windows array writer bg3.exe+0xA7FD00 writes 1 byte at +0x10. Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0x5D7C70 copies it from request +0x14 = the second argument of the SwapPlaces stats functor (functor +0x4C; Script Extender SwapPlacesFunctor::Arg1); EoCServer.dll+0x1517940 passes it to the animation gameplay event EoCGE::PositionSwap(isSource, +0x10, +0x11), whose parameter names are not in the binaries.

fields.name: field_11
fields.evidence: Windows array writer bg3.exe+0xA7FD00 writes 1 byte at +0x11. Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0x5D7C70 copies it from request +0x15 = the third argument of the SwapPlaces functor (functor +0x4D; Script Extender Arg2); passed to EoCGE::PositionSwap like +0x10.

second_pass: Settled on Windows: the creator bg3.exe+0x2E9F6E0 writes the owner entity at +0 and an empty array at +8; the array writer bg3.exe+0xA7FD00 gives the element (two entities, two bytes, stride 0x18).
